mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a high of 55 degrees with partly cloudy conditions at Harriet Park and a full moon tonight. While the space station will be passing overhead this evening, we unfortunately won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, a portion of Hwy M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for final paving and road improvements. Please follow the posted detour signs using Old PB, E Verona Ave, and S Main St. Additionally, please remain vigilant against scam emails asking for permit fees; remember that the City of Verona only accepts check payments delivered to City Hall.

There is plenty to do in our community this weekend. Today you can catch live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is a yoga session at Insight Wellness, followed by a busy week featuring Tuesday trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.

Regarding local law enforcement, on September 5, officers investigated a series of reports involving vehicles with cheese slices placed on their windshields in various downtown locations, which was identified as a social media trend.
If you are looking for a sweet treat, Culver's is currently open until 10 PM and is serving their delicious Turtle flavor of the day.
